title: YOU ARE LOSING $240 EVERY MONTH
_doc: Dre, 2026-09-04: '15-20 sec max, get to the point' and 'I need way better professional transitions and hooks.' THE HOOK NOW OBEYS DRE'S OWN TEMPLATE (memory: feedback-wick-hooks) which the first cut violated: 'WHERE DID IT GO?' carried no number and no emotion. The loss shape with a round number is the law — the film then proves the figure ($300 saved first minus $60 saved last = $240 a month). TRANSITIONS are assigned per cut, not uniform: push when the argument advances, matchCut across the diagram shots so the bar never resets, dip to black before the payoff, wipe at the turn to the solution.

shots.vo: You are losing two hundred and forty dollars every month. Here is where it goes.
shots.art: A candle character standing alone in a dim apartment at night, looking down at a phone in his hand, the screen the only bright thing in the room. Wide shot, he is small in the frame, the room large and quiet around him.

shots.vo: Rent and bills you can name. That part is easy.
But after everything else, only sixty dollars was left to save.
Take it first instead of last, and the same paycheck saves three hundred.
That is two hundred and forty dollars a month you already had. Set one transfer tonight.
shots.art: A candle character sitting on the edge of a bed at night, phone held in both hands, the screen glowing warmly on his face. Calm and settled, the room dark around him.
